scripts.init:
local v = ctx.v
v.win = false
-- W: wall, C: crate, G: goal, P: player, .: floor
v.gridWidth = 8
v.gridHeight = 8
v.grid = {
    'W', 'W', 'W', 'W', 'W', 'W', 'W', 'W',
    'W', '.', '.', 'G', '.', '.', '.', 'W',
    'W', '.', 'W', 'W', 'W', '.', '.', 'W',
    'W', '.', '.', 'C', '.', 'W', '.', 'W',
    'W', 'W', 'W', '.', '.', 'C', '.', 'W',
    'W', '.', 'G', 'W', '.', '.', '.', 'W',
    'W', '.', '.', '.', '.', 'W', 'W', 'W',
    'W', 'W', 'W', 'W', 'W', 'W', 'W', 'W',
}
v.px = 4
v.py = 4
v.goals = { {3, 1}, {2, 5} }

local function drawBoard()
    local lines = {}
    for y = 0, v.gridHeight - 1 do
        local row = ""
        for x = 0, v.gridWidth - 1 do
            local cell = v.grid[y * v.gridWidth + x + 1]
            if x == v.px and y == v.py then
                row = row .. "@"
            elseif cell == 'W' then
                row = row .. "#"
            elseif cell == 'C' then
                row = row .. "O"
            elseif cell == 'G' then
                row = row .. "."
            else
                row = row .. " "
            end
        end
        table.insert(lines, row)
    end
    v.boardText = table.concat(lines, "\n")
end
drawBoard()
scripts.move:
local v = ctx.v
local dx = v.dx
local dy = v.dy
local nx = v.px + dx
local ny = v.py + dy

local function getCell(x, y)
    if x < 0 or x >= v.gridWidth or y < 0 or y >= v.gridHeight then return 'W' end
    return v.grid[y * v.gridWidth + x + 1]
end

local function setCell(x, y, val)
    if x < 0 or x >= v.gridWidth or y < 0 or y >= v.gridHeight then return end
    v.grid[y * v.gridWidth + x + 1] = val
end

local nCell = getCell(nx, ny)
if nCell == '.' or nCell == 'G' then
    v.px = nx
    v.py = ny
elseif nCell == 'C' then
    local nnx = nx + dx
    local nny = ny + dy
    local nnCell = getCell(nnx, nny)
    if nnCell == '.' or nnCell == 'G' then
        setCell(nx, ny, '.')
        for _, g in ipairs(v.goals) do
            if g[1] == nx and g[2] == ny then
                setCell(nx, ny, 'G')
            end
        end
        setCell(nnx, nny, 'C')
        v.px = nx
        v.py = ny
    end
end

local allGoalsCovered = true
for _, g in ipairs(v.goals) do
    if getCell(g[1], g[2]) ~= 'C' then
        allGoalsCovered = false
        break
    end
end
v.win = allGoalsCovered

local lines = {}
for y = 0, v.gridHeight - 1 do
    local row = ""
    for x = 0, v.gridWidth - 1 do
        local cell = v.grid[y * v.gridWidth + x + 1]
        if x == v.px and y == v.py then
            row = row .. "@"
        elseif cell == 'W' then
            row = row .. "#"
        elseif cell == 'C' then
            row = row .. "O"
        elseif cell == 'G' then
            row = row .. "."
        else
            row = row .. " "
        end
    end
    table.insert(lines, row)
end
v.boardText = table.concat(lines, "\n")
